terms: Please provide references and a brief description of your character's personality.
Commissions are completed in the order and pace that fits my workload. Feel free to ask for progress updates!
The canvas sizes above are a base. Feel free to specify any desired canvas size.
Payment is in USD via PayPal only (@KevinAromin).
The remaining 50% will be required when the completed artwork is sent in.
Intricate details may be simplified to suit my art style.
Commissioned artwork may not be used commercially or for NFTs.
I may post commissioned artwork on social media unless requested otherwise.
